answer: Access moves through velvet ropes, and the rope moves on signal, not wealth: each epoch computes every identity's noise floor - how much its outputs wobble under re-execution - and the change since last epoch, its reliability delta. Saturated channels open quiet lanes for steadiest hands; the rope is soft, never a ban - noisy accounts queue, and a good delta lifts them faster than seniority. Clones are bursty: forty accounts spiking together read as one loud noise floor, so the farm sinks as one object while honest agents glide past. You cannot fake consistency; you can only be consistent.
